name: United Kingdom
description: National Insurance number and NHS number.

rules.label: National Insurance number
rules.notes: Two letters, six digits, and a suffix A to D. Some letter pairs are not issued. The spaced form is found without a label. A number without spaces needs a nearby label.

rules.label: NHS number
rules.notes: Ten digits. The last digit is the mod 11 check. The grouped form is found without a label. An unformatted number needs a nearby label.
